"import cadquery as cq

# L-bracket parameters (mm), hard-coded per task spec
LEG_X = 120.0      # horizontal leg length along +X (x from 0 to 120)
H = 80.0           # vertical leg height along +Z (z from 0 to 80)
T = 10.0           # leg thickness (both legs)
WID = 60.0         # shared width along +Y (y from 0 to 60)
FILLET_R = 15.0    # inner concave fillet radius
HOLE_D = 10.0      # through-hole diameter in each leg
HX = 65.0          # horizontal-leg hole center x (axis parallel to Z)
HY = 30.0          # hole center y (both legs)
VZ = 45.0          # vertical-leg hole center z (axis parallel to X)
OVER = 1.0         # cylinder overshoot to avoid coplanar boolean degeneracy

# L-profile sketched on XZ with the inner fillet drawn into the section
# (fillet tangent to top of horizontal leg at x = T+R, z = T and to inner
# face of vertical leg at x = T, z = T+R; arc bulges toward the inner corner)
profile = (cq.Workplane("XZ")
           .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
           .lineTo(LEG_X, 0.0)          # bottom face of horizontal leg
           .lineTo(LEG_X, T)            # right end face (sharp outer corner)
           .lineTo(T + FILLET_R, T)     # top face of horizontal leg to tangent point
           .threePointArc((T + FILLET_R - FILLET_R / (2.0 ** 0.5),
                           T + FILLET_R - FILLET_R / (2.0 ** 0.5)),
                          (T, T + FILLET_R))  # inner concave fillet, radius 15
           .lineTo(T, H)                # inner face of vertical leg
           .lineTo(0.0, H)              # top face (sharp outer corner)
           .close()                     # left outer face back to origin
           .extrude(WID))

solid = profile.val()
if solid.Center().y < 0.0:              # extrusion along -Y normal: shift to y in [0, WID]
    solid = solid.translate(cq.Vector(0.0, WID, 0.0))

# Through holes cut with slightly over-long cylinders (never flush/coincident
# end faces): horizontal-leg hole along Z at (x=65, y=30);
# vertical-leg hole along X at (y=30, z=45)
hole_h = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(HOLE_D / 2.0, T + 2.0 * OVER,
                               cq.Vector(HX, HY, -OVER), cq.Vector(0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
hole_v = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(HOLE_D / 2.0, T + 2.0 * OVER,
                               cq.Vector(-OVER, HY, VZ), cq.Vector(1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
solid = solid.cut(hole_h).cut(hole_v)

cq.exporters.export(solid, "part.step")"
